title: Tag questions: guided practice
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.explanationEs: Frase afirmativa con is: tag negativa, isn't it?
Frase negativa con don't: tag afirmativa, do you?

items.statement: They went to the party, didn't they?
items.explanationEs: Pasado sin auxiliar (went): la tag usa did, en negativa: didn't they?
El auxiliar de la frase es can: She can swim, can't she?

answers: You've been to Paris, haven't you?
items.explanationEs: El auxiliar de la frase es have ('ve): haven't you?
Frase negativa con isn't: tag afirmativa, is he?
